title: Service Recovery Guideline: Missed-Earning Apology Rate (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
When a **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** missed earning is posted for an Autoship shipment, a missed-earning apology rate is added to the missed-earning rate, in points per qualifying dollar. It depends on two facts from the membership's own records:

- **months enrolled** — full calendar months from the membership's enrollment date to the posting date;
- **recent earning entries** — the points-earning entries on the rewards ledger dated in the last three months.

**Guideline.** A membership enrolled for at least 60 months that also has at least 3 points-earning entries dated in the last three months adds 1.0 point per dollar. A membership that does not meet both of those conditions but is enrolled for at least 24 months and has at least one points-earning entry dated in the last three months adds 0.5 point per dollar. Any other membership adds no missed-earning apology rate.

## Combinations

| Months enrolled | Points-earning entries in the last three months | Apology rate added |
|---|---|---|
| 60 or more | 3 or more | 1.0 |
| 60 or more | 1 or 2 | 0.5 |
| 60 or more | 0 | none |
| 24 to 59 | 1 or more | 0.5 |
| 24 to 59 | 0 | none |
| fewer than 24 | any number | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- 60 full months enrolled, exactly 3 recent entries: 1.0. One month fewer (59), same entries: 0.5.
- 24 full months enrolled, one recent entry: 0.5. With 23 months: none.
- 72 months enrolled, 2 recent entries: 0.5 — the 60-month condition is met but the entry count is not, so the 24-month line applies.
